text:
claire: Quick heads-up 11 weird onboarding report: users on Windows PowerShell copy the README curl block and it silently drops the newline, making the --data payload merge with headers.
tony: oof. can you paste the exact snippet from the README?
claire: current quickstart shows this cURL block for POST: 
```
curl -X POST \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  --retry 2
```
nina: on some Windows terminals, when users copy the triple-backtick block, the backslashes are dropped and lines join; result is header lines concatenated with the JSON body -> 400 or weird server parsing errors.
claire: support saw >5 tickets where the customer pasted the snippet into a CI file and their runner failed with "400 malformed header".
docs-bot: linter note: docs snippets using line-continuation backslashes are fragile in Windows copy/paste. Recommend examples include single-line variants or explicit PowerShell examples.
tony: two problems here: (1) fragility of backslash line-continuation in docs, (2) inconsistent retry guidance for POST across language quickstarts. Node says "auto retry", Python shows explicit RetryConfig, Java suggests using client.setRetry(). Confusing.
claire: proposed fixes: (a) replace backslash-continued curl block with a single-line curl example and a multi-line PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod example; (b) remove `--retry` from the canonical POST quickstart and add an Idempotency-Key header example if we show retries; (c) add a short note about SDK retry parity and link to an SDK issue.
support: customers said removing --retry in the snippet immediately stopped duplicate requests in their CI.
docs-bot: created issue #5230: "quickstart: windows copy/paste robustness + retry/idempotency guidance". Template recommends adding single-line versions for copy/paste and aligning retry callouts across languages.
eng-runtime: FYI server treats headers strictly; trimming might help some users but could mask token rotation bugs. We'll discuss but docs fix is lower-risk.
claire: i'll open a micro-PR changing the quickstart: single-line curl, explicit Idempotency-Key example, PowerShell snippet, and a small callout about retry behavior across SDKs.
mina: can we also add a test to our docs CI that tries copying code blocks (smoke test) in both Unix and Windows modes? if we automate copy/paste we can catch these before they ship.
docs-bot: noted. added CI checklist item to issue #5230 requesting a snippet copy/paste smoke test in docs CI.
tonY: (typo) ignore
claire: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2684 - includes single-line curl and PowerShell examples + a callout "Avoid --retry on POST unless you include Idempotency-Key".
support: confirmed with one customer: after updating quickstart their CI job stopped failing. thank you.
deploy-bot: PR #2684 merged and deployed to staging docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/quickstart. :shipit:
claire: closing loop. small docs ergonomics win with real customer impact. :tada:
